doc.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Accompanying Billie Holiday
summary: In 1952 he accompanied Billie Holiday on radio, at the Apollo and at Club Harlem in Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Oh Billie Holiday, I did several radio programs accompanying her and at the Apollo Theater I also accompanied her. Corporan:What era?
That was 1952. In Atlantic City and I also accompanied her in the club . . . Club Harlem in Atlantic City. I accompanied her here at the Apollo theater and then in Newark at a radio station.
Very quiet but also with a great deal of experience and a sense of what art is. A phenomenon.
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. When she was working, she would give all of her soul, her whole being.
